correctness.rationale: For n≥3 and 0≤m≤⌊n/2⌋, the disjoint-edge difference vectors define an orthogonal projector W with L=nP−2W and L^+=(1/n)P+(1/(n−2)−1/n)W. The column simplex has inward facet normals L^+e_i. Squaring L^+ yields exactly four negative off-diagonal Gram patterns, hence the stated acute cosines c,c/√k,c/k,(c+k−1)/k, their exhaustive pair multiplicities and exact matching recovery. The n^{-2} arcsine expansion and exact ridge-type frequencies give 1−Binomial(2,2ρ) in distribution; the m exceptional ridges vanish in probability despite scaled divergence. Independent exact matrix reconstruction for 1,118 tested facets corroborated the identities; finite checks alone do not prove the limits.
